collection.description: A child learns to hold a butterfly net without tearing it.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (Name1), a child, learns to hold a butterfly net without tearing it. (Name1) is amazed by a pattern almost invisible from afar.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (Name1), a child, learns to hold a butterfly net without tearing it. A sudden flutter makes the youngest observer laugh.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (Name1), a child, learns to hold a butterfly net without tearing it. Someone sketches the colors before forgetting them.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (Name1), a child, learns to hold a butterfly net without tearing it. The group stays a little longer, hoping to see another species.
